claim: Kestra represents workflows as declarative YAML Flow definitions composed of standard and Flowable tasks (DAG, Parallel, Sequential, Loop), dynamically evaluated by Executor handlers.
mechanism: Flow model contains task definitions. DefaultExecutor listens to execution events, evaluates flowable dependencies, and emits new WorkerTask instances as upstream tasks finish.
applicabilityConditions: All Kestra Flow definitions and execution runs
localContext: Flow model contains task definitions. DefaultExecutor listens to execution events, evaluates flowable dependencies, and emits new WorkerTask instances as upstream tasks finish. Known limits: Flow graph syntax and task property validation occurs prior to queue dispatch.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Flow models declarative orchestration graphs, containing top-level metadata, tasks list, error handlers, concurrency limits, and trigger definitions.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that shrinking loop values between iterations fails only the execution cleanly without crashing the executor.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Added boundary check in LoopExecutionEventMessageHandler to catch iteration shrinkage and fail only the affected execution instance.

claim: Executors, Workers, and Schedulers communicate strictly through asynchronous typed message queues (QueueInterface), decoupling execution decisions from compute tasks.
mechanism: Executors publish WorkerTask messages to QueueInterface. Workers poll tasks, execute logic, and publish WorkerTaskResult back to the queue, triggering subsequent Executor iterations.
applicabilityConditions: All Kestra deployments across queue implementations (JDBC Queue, Kafka Queue)
localContext: Executors publish WorkerTask messages to QueueInterface. Workers poll tasks, execute logic, and publish WorkerTaskResult back to the queue, triggering subsequent Executor iterations. Known limits: Requires reliable message delivery guarantees and at-least-once processing semantics.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: QueueInterface defines emit, receive, and poll methods for event-driven message distribution across Executor, Worker, and Scheduler components.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that streaming execution flux completes only after the terminated execution is persisted in the repository.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Moved FollowExecutionEvent emission to execute strictly post-commit in the executor failure path.

claim: Inter-task intermediate files and large payloads are written directly to StorageInterface via internal kestra:// URIs, preventing message queue payload bloat and memory exhaustion.
mechanism: StorageInterface stores files in local disk, MinIO, S3, or GCS. TaskRun outputs contain only URI references (kestra://...) passed across message queues.
applicabilityConditions: All task executions generating file outputs or consuming large inputs
localContext: StorageInterface stores files in local disk, MinIO, S3, or GCS. TaskRun outputs contain only URI references (kestra://...) passed across message queues. Known limits: Requires shared storage backend accessible across all worker nodes in distributed deployments.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: TaskRun tracks individual task execution lifecycle, parent/child taskRun hierarchy, iteration indexes, retry counts, and input/output payload maps.

claim: Flow concurrency limits enforce bounded concurrent active runs per tenant/flow, with cancellation fences preventing duplicate concurrency slot releases on SLA timeouts.
mechanism: Executor tracks active flow counts. ExecutionKilledExecutionMessageHandler handles timeout cancellation and fences slot release logic to ensure exactly-once slot decrements.
applicabilityConditions: Flows configured with concurrency limits and MaxDurationSLA rules
localContext: Executor tracks active flow counts. ExecutionKilledExecutionMessageHandler handles timeout cancellation and fences slot release logic to ensure exactly-once slot decrements. Known limits: Queued executions exceeding concurrency limits remain in QUEUED state until active executions complete.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Execution.withState validates state transitions against allowed lifecycles (CREATED, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, PAUSED, KILLED) and appends state history timestamps.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that killing a subflow via SLA returns the flow concurrency running counter back to exactly zero without double release.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Added concurrency slot release fencing to prevent duplicate decrement calls when a subflow execution is killed by SLA.

claim: High-concurrency database storage layers must recursively inspect nested cause chains and suppressed exceptions to reliably detect database deadlocks and trigger automated retries.
mechanism: JooqDSLContextWrapper inspects exception cause hierarchies for SQLState deadlock codes (40P01, 40001, 1213), triggering transaction retry loops.
applicabilityConditions: Kestra JDBC repository operations under high concurrent execution load
localContext: JooqDSLContextWrapper inspects exception cause hierarchies for SQLState deadlock codes (40P01, 40001, 1213), triggering transaction retry loops. Known limits: Max retry attempts and exponential backoff prevent indefinite retry loops on permanent transaction conflicts.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: JooqDSLContextWrapper intercepts database exceptions, recursively inspects cause chains and suppressed exceptions for SQL deadlock error codes, and triggers retries.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that JooqDSLContextWrapper recognizes deadlock SQLState error codes nested two levels deep in exception cause chains.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Enhanced JooqDSLContextWrapper deadlock predicate to recursively traverse exception cause chains and suppressed exceptions.

claim: Subflow task execution spawns independent child Execution instances linked to parent TaskRun IDs, propagating cancellation signals downwards while isolating failures.
mechanism: Subflow task emits child Execution. Parent executor tracks subflow status. Canceling or killing parent flow propagates kill commands to all active child subflow executions.
localContext: Subflow task emits child Execution. Parent executor tracks subflow status. Canceling or killing parent flow propagates kill commands to all active child subflow executions. Known limits: Subflows configured with transmitFailed=false allow parent flows to continue even if the child execution fails.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: Execution.withState validates state transitions against allowed lifecycles (CREATED, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, PAUSED, KILLED) and appends state history timestamps.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Added concurrency slot release fencing to prevent duplicate decrement calls when a subflow execution is killed by SLA.

claim: Worker agents isolate task executions in dedicated temporary working directories, downloading input storage files and capturing generated output artifacts.
mechanism: WorkerTaskProcessor creates a temp directory per taskRun, downloads kestra:// URI files from StorageInterface, executes the runner, uploads output files, and purges the directory.
applicabilityConditions: Task executions across Process, Docker, and Script runners
localContext: WorkerTaskProcessor creates a temp directory per taskRun, downloads kestra:// URI files from StorageInterface, executes the runner, uploads output files, and purges the directory. Known limits: Worker disk capacity must accommodate concurrent task working directory footprints.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: StorageInterface provides put, get, delete, and list operations for durable blob storage across local filesystem, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob.

claim: Workflow definition parsers enforce upper bounds on user-supplied duration strings across retry, SLA, and time window configs to prevent arithmetic overflow in timer calculations.
mechanism: DurationMax validator checks duration fields during flow parsing, rejecting values greater than 10 years and preventing runtime overflow.
applicabilityConditions: All Flow task retry policies, SLA configurations, and trigger time windows
localContext: DurationMax validator checks duration fields during flow parsing, rejecting values greater than 10 years and preventing runtime overflow. Known limits: Flows with invalid durations fail validation immediately upon upload or deployment.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: AbstractRetry encapsulates retry behavior (Constant, Exponential, Random), validating maximum duration bounds and calculating retry backoff intervals.

testProvenance.assertionSnippet: Asserts that DurationMax validator rejects retry intervals greater than the maximum supported duration boundary.

historyProvenance.fixDescription: Added DurationMax annotation and validation to enforce bounds on user-supplied durations across retry, SLA, and time window configs.

claim: Remote worker pools connect to controller nodes via bidirectional gRPC streams, dispatching tasks based on real-time worker capacity metrics.
mechanism: WorkerJobDispatcher manages streaming gRPC connections, tracks worker thread availability and capacity metrics, and pushes tasks directly to available worker nodes.
applicabilityConditions: Distributed Kestra worker deployments with worker-controller
localContext: WorkerJobDispatcher manages streaming gRPC connections, tracks worker thread availability and capacity metrics, and pushes tasks directly to available worker nodes. Known limits: Worker network disconnections trigger task re-queueing by the worker controller after heartbeat timeout.
